phase: Exploratory source audit followed by fixed real-data validity checks. Not a preregistered estimate of population prevalence.

panel.gold_rule: Exact correct_answer text matched to displayed choices
Nonempty answer is one-based index; blank answer means unavailable gold
Boolean answer matched to intended literal choices true,false
ideal is correct text; distractors should not be mistaken for complete choice set
Correct Answer text; preserve gated outcome without using credentials or alternative mirrors

selection_disclosure: Panel selected after schema/config inspection identified literal-label, one-based-index, fixed-answer-position and incomplete-options hypotheses; control benchmarks explicitly included. No model outcome inspection used for selection.
primary_checks: Run unmodified One-Eval preprocessing methods on official data and record unresolved input fields; do not describe blocked generation as successful end-to-end scoring.
Validate gold availability and whether the correct answer appears among displayed options.
Through unmodified run_bench_with_contract, score known-correct letter-oracle responses and every constant-letter baseline against the gallery default reference field and parser.
Compare scores to semantic source gold independently of One-Eval label parser. Retain unavailable-gold cases as invalid coverage, not incorrect answers.
Verify reference-encoding preservation using explicit per-source label base and literal semantics; zero-based control tasks must remain correct.

For fixed-position SciQ, use deterministic balanced option rotations across source rows, preserve semantic gold, and test constant-letter baselines plus oracle against corrected displayed-choice contract.
controls: All observed rows in each acquired split; no correctness-based filtering.
For very large public splits above 20000 rows, use deterministic SHA256 order first20000 without model outcomes; retain full capture.
No new model inference in this stage. Oracles and constant predictors are constructed diagnostic controls, never real model outputs.
Gated or acquisition-failed sources remain in the disposition table.
Diagnostic split overrides identified separately from native gallery defaults.
Record proxy labels and readiness warnings; do not call an explicitly marked proxy an undisclosed official evaluation.
promotion_gate: A source-level issue is promoted only with real-source reproduction, actual reachable route evidence, causal correction, clear scope, and material effect. No claim that prior authors' published model results are invalid without their run artifacts.
